description: Searches for person records matching the given criteria (wraps NBAPI SearchPersonData). Every documented SearchPersonData filter field is modeled explicitly; omit all filters to return every record.

ACCESSLEVEL.description: Optional. Match persons assigned this access level.

ACCESSLEVELDETAILS.description: Optional. Include full access level details in the response.

BLUEDIAMONDENABLED.description: Optional. Match on whether BlueDiamond mobile credentials are enabled ("TRUE"/"FALSE").

CARDFORMAT.description: Optional. Match persons holding a card in this card format.

CARDSTATUS.description: Optional. Match persons holding a card with this card status name.

CONTACTEMAIL.description: Optional. Match on the person's office email address.

FIRSTNAME.description: Optional. Match on the person's first name.

HOTSTAMP.description: Optional. Match on a card hot-stamp number.

LASTNAME.description: Optional. Match on the person's last name.

MIDDLENAME.description: Optional. Match on the person's middle name.

MOBILEPHONE.description: Optional. Match on the person's mobile phone number.

MSUENABLED.description: Optional. Match on whether MSU mobile credentials are enabled ("TRUE"/"FALSE").

NEWESTLASTMOD.description: Optional. Only include records last modified on/before this date/time.

NOTES.description: Optional. Match on the person record's notes text.

OLDESTLASTMOD.description: Optional. Only include records last modified on/after this date/time.

PERSONID.description: Optional. Match on a specific PERSONID.

RAWCARDNUMBER.description: Optional. Match on a raw (unformatted) card number.

UDF1.description: Optional. Search filter on user-defined field UDF1.

UDF10.description: Optional. Search filter on user-defined field UDF10.

UDF11.description: Optional. Search filter on user-defined field UDF11.

UDF12.description: Optional. Search filter on user-defined field UDF12.

UDF13.description: Optional. Search filter on user-defined field UDF13.

UDF14.description: Optional. Search filter on user-defined field UDF14.

UDF15.description: Optional. Search filter on user-defined field UDF15.

UDF16.description: Optional. Search filter on user-defined field UDF16.

UDF17.description: Optional. Search filter on user-defined field UDF17.

UDF18.description: Optional. Search filter on user-defined field UDF18.

UDF19.description: Optional. Search filter on user-defined field UDF19.

UDF2.description: Optional. Search filter on user-defined field UDF2.

UDF20.description: Optional. Search filter on user-defined field UDF20.

UDF3.description: Optional. Search filter on user-defined field UDF3.

UDF4.description: Optional. Search filter on user-defined field UDF4.

UDF5.description: Optional. Search filter on user-defined field UDF5.

UDF6.description: Optional. Search filter on user-defined field UDF6.

UDF7.description: Optional. Search filter on user-defined field UDF7.

UDF8.description: Optional. Search filter on user-defined field UDF8.

UDF9.description: Optional. Search filter on user-defined field UDF9.

VEHICLELICNUM.description: Optional. Match on a vehicle license plate number.

VEHICLETAGNUM.description: Optional. Match on a vehicle tag number.

WANTCREDENTIALID.description: Optional. Include CREDENTIALID values on returned access cards.

WILDCARDSEARCH.description: Optional. Treat text filters as wildcard patterns.
